dishes.name: Biscuit rose de Reims
dishes.desc: A pink, vanilla-flavoured biscuit made in Reims since 1691. Crisp and light, designed for dunking.

dishes.name: Massepain de Reims
dishes.desc: Soft almond marzipan biscuits made in Reims since the Middle Ages. Often packed in boxes for gifts.

dishes.name: Reims gingerbread
dishes.desc: A dense honey and spice bread, a Reims confectioner's speciality for centuries. Sold in slices or as small cakes.

dishes.name: Jambon de Reims
dishes.desc: Pressed ham set in aspic with parsley, served cold in slices. A Reims charcuterie classic.

dishes.name: Moutarde de Reims
dishes.desc: A coarse-ground wholegrain mustard made in Reims since the Middle Ages. Used with ham and sold in local épiceries.
